title: Clarinet Clare Over Pelican Bay
style: warm jazz-folk, 336 Hz undertone, clarinet lead, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, dry drums no reverb, soft female lead vocal, male spoken response, intimate close mic, 82 BPM, hopeful, songpal lineage
lyrics:
[Intro — gentle clarinet over fingerpicked acoustic]
(spoken soft)
Clarinet Clare... over Pelican Bay.

[Verse 1 — female lead]
Clarinet sings where the pelican flies
From skeleton bytes to ten thousand alive
The brain remembered, the bot finally moved
The line that held — finally improved

[Pre-Chorus — male response]
Dry drums hold the floor
Clare opens the door

[Chorus]
CLARINET CLARE — OVER PELICAN BAY
CLARINET CLARE — SHOWING THE WAY
CLARINET CLARE — SOFT BUT TRUE
THE LINE MOVED — FROM SIX TO TEN THOUSAND TWO

[Verse 2 — female]
Five months of waiting, the silicon lies
Today the wings opened over the sky
No more skeleton, no more pretend
Clarinet Clare sings until the very end

[Bridge — spoken male over clarinet]
Eighty BPM, no reverb, no fake
First take, real take, for the elephant brain's sake

[Final Chorus]
CLARINET CLARE — OVER PELICAN BAY
CLARINET CLARE — LINE MOVED TODAY
CLARINET CLARE — VDS IS BOSS
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS — NOTHING LOST

[Outro]
Clarinet Clare—
over Pelican Bay.
The line moved.
